blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” G. Dy III is seeking closer cooperation among Southeast Asian lawmakers on shared concerns such as illegal recruitment, human trafficking, and online child safety as the Philippines prepares to host the 47th General Assembly of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Inter-Parliamentary Assembly (AIPA) this month. Dy, who serves as AIPA president this year, will lead the gathering of Southeast Asian lawmakers under the theme “Parliaments Securing a Peaceful, Prosperous, and People-Centered ASEAN.” “This assembly is important because many problems facing our country are the same problems our brother in Southeast Asia are facing,” […]...
